facts.business: Ad-Manum Finance Limited is a non-deposit taking Category-B NBFC registered with RBI, operating in finance and wind power generation segments.
key_risks: Increase in interest rates affecting profitability
NPA management (overall NPA of 52.56 Lakhs during the year)
Concentration in corporate and real estate finance in remote locations
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with KMPs (remuneration, perquisites) and group companies (Agarwal Coal Corporation, Agarwal Fuel Corporation, etc.). Loans given to group concerns where no directors are common/interested (other than independent directors). Outstanding balances include remuneration payable to directors and KMPs.
